name: portfolio value, donut and holdings bars build in turn
looks: A headline lands, then a big currency total counts up above a line chart that draws left to right with a dot at its tip. It cuts to a new headline with a donut chart drawing its ring and a short legend ticking in row by row. It cuts again to a ranked list of horizontal bars growing out from zero next to their percentages.
build: Each beat is a shutters-style infographic build: the counter's digits roll up under a blur tied to speed; the spline draws with strokeDashoffset and a travelling dot; the donut's stroke-dashoffset animates from full to its value; the bars scaleY/scaleX from a zero origin on an uneven stagger (about 0.042s * jitter), with the top bar in the accent colour. Mono labels clip in beside each element.
sound: A rising tone under each counter and draw, blips on the bars and legend rows landing on a sixteenth grid.
prompt: Build a short run of data cards: a headline with a total that counts up over a line chart drawing to a point, a donut chart filling to its value with a short legend, and a ranked list of bars growing out to their percentages. Keep every number labelled and let each build land on its own beat before the next headline cuts in.
